technicalForensics.vpnEngine: Legacy de.blinkt.openvpn (ics-openvpn) wrapper using static .ovpn TCP/UDP configs fetched over remote JSON API. No WireGuard, no AmneziaWG, no DPI obfuscation.
technicalForensics.serverReality: 1–2 overloaded low-end Cairo VPS nodes + automatic silent fallback to European datacenter IPs (M247 / CloudSigma / Choopa) shared by 1,500+ concurrent free users.
technicalForensics.ipqsFraudScore: 85–100 (Flagged vpn: true, proxy: true, high abuse velocity)
technicalForensics.uxFailurePattern: Forces unskippable video interstitial ads on app launch, before connect, after connect, on server list open, and on disconnect (~30 forced ads in 5 minutes). Paid IAP users report ads still persist.
leakFailures: Dual-Stack IPv6 Leak: Does not sinkhole ::/0 IPv6 routes, exposing the user's real Saudi (STC) or Emirati (e&) IPv6 address to Egyptian bank apps while connected.
No enforced system-wide kill switch on connection drop.
Public DNS fallback leaks outside the tunnel.
technicalForensics.iosPresence: None — Cannot pass Apple App Store Guideline 5.4 due to third-party ad trackers and individual/clone account restrictions.
